scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:studio: if [ ! -f apps/studio/.env.local ]; then echo "Missing apps/studio/.env.local. Download the local environment bundle from Demo Library." >&2; exit 1; fi; export SANITY_STUDIO_HOST="$(node -e 'const {readFileSync}=require("node:fs");const {parseEnv}=require("node:util");process.stdout.write(parseEnv(readFileSync("apps/studio/.env.local", "utf8")).SANITY_STUDIO_HOST ?? "")')"; if [ -z "$SANITY_STUDIO_HOST" ]; then echo "Missing SANITY_STUDIO_HOST in apps/studio/.env.local. Download a new local environment bundle from Demo Library." >&2; exit 1; fi; pnpm --dir apps/studio exec sanity deploy --url "$SANITY_STUDIO_HOST" --yes
